entries.title: John 3:1
segments: Now there was a Pharisee named Nicodemus, who was a leading man among the Jews.

entries.title: John 3:2
segments: This man came to Jesus by night, and said to him: "Rabbi, we know that you are a Teacher come from God; for no one could give such signs as you are giving, unless God were with him."

entries.title: John 3:3
segments: "In truth I tell you," exclaimed Jesus, "unless a man is reborn, he cannot see the Kingdom of God."

entries.title: John 3:4
segments: "How can a man," asked Nicodemus, "be born when he is old? Can he be born a second time?"

entries.title: John 3:5
segments: "In truth I tell you," answered Jesus, "unless a man owes his birth to Water and Spirit, he cannot enter the Kingdom of God.

entries.title: John 3:6
segments: All that owes its birth to human nature is human, and all that owes its birth to the Spirit is spiritual.

entries.title: John 3:7
segments: Do not wonder at my telling you that you all need to be reborn.

entries.title: John 3:8
segments: The wind blows where it wills, and you can hear the sound of it, but you do not know whence it comes, or where it goes; it is the same with every one that owes his birth to the Spirit."

entries.title: John 3:9
segments: "How can that be?" asked Nicodemus.

entries.title: John 3:10
segments: "What! You a teacher of Israel," exclaimed Jesus, "and yet do not understand this!

entries.title: John 3:11
segments: In truth I tell you that we speak of what we know, and state what we have seen; and yet you do not accept our statements.

entries.title: John 3:12
segments: If, when I tell you earthly things, you do not believe me, how will you believe me when I tell you of heavenly things?

entries.title: John 3:13
segments: No one has ascended to Heaven, except him who descended from Heaven--the Son of Man himself.

entries.title: John 3:14
segments: And, as Moses lifted up the serpent in the desert, so must the Son of Man be lifted up;

entries.title: John 3:15
segments: That every one who believes in him may have Immortal Life."

entries.title: John 3:16
segments: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only Son, that every one who believes in him may not be lost, but have Immortal Life.

entries.title: John 3:17
segments: For God did not send his Son into the world to condemn the world, but that the world might be saved through him.

entries.title: John 3:18
segments: He who believes in him escapes condemnation, while he who does not believe in him is already condemned, because he has not believed in the only Son of God.

entries.title: John 3:19
segments: The ground of his condemnation is this, that though the Light has come into the world, men preferred the darkness to the Light, because their actions were wicked.

entries.title: John 3:20
segments: For he who lives an evil life hates the light, and will not come to it, for fear that his actions should be exposed;

entries.title: John 3:21
segments: But he who acts up to the truth comes to the light, that his actions may be shown to have been done in dependence upon God.

entries.title: John 3:22
segments: After this, Jesus went with his disciples into the country parts of Judea; and there he stayed with them, and baptized.

entries.title: John 3:23
segments: John, also, was baptizing at Aenon near Salim, because there were many streams there; and people were constantly coming and being baptized.

entries.title: John 3:24
segments: (For John had not yet been imprisoned).

entries.title: John 3:25
segments: Now a discussion arose between some of John's disciples and a Jew on the subject of 'purification;'

entries.title: John 3:26
segments: And the disciples came to John and said: "Rabbi, the man who was with you on the other side of the Jordan, and to whom you have yourself borne testimony--he, also, is baptizing, and everybody is going to him."

entries.title: John 3:27
segments: John's answer was--"A man can gain nothing but what is given him from Heaven.

entries.title: John 3:28
segments: You are yourselves witnesses that I said 'I am not the Christ,' but 'I have been sent before him as a Messenger.'

entries.title: John 3:29
segments: It is the bridegroom who has the bride; but the bridegroom's friend, who stands by and listens to him, is filled with joy when he hears the bridegroom's voice. This joy I have felt to the full.

entries.title: John 3:30
segments: He must become greater, and I less."

entries.title: John 3:31
segments: He who comes from above is above all others; but a child of earth is earthly, and his teaching is earthly, too. He who comes from Heaven is above all others.

entries.title: John 3:32
segments: He states what he has seen and what he heard, and yet no one accepts his statement.

entries.title: John 3:33
segments: They who did accept his statement attested the fact that God is true.

entries.title: John 3:34
segments: For he whom God sent as his Messenger gives us God's own teaching, for God does not limit the gift of the Spirit.

entries.title: John 3:35
segments: The Father loves his Son, and has put everything in his hands.

entries.title: John 3:36
segments: He who believes in the Son has Immortal Life, while he who rejects the Son will not even see that Life, but remains under 'God's displeasure.'
